assets.name: panel
assets.prompt: Generate a NEW production game UI panel sprite for the railway interface in Eternal Steam. The attached tiny sprite is STYLE REFERENCE only. Match its restrained flat industrial strategy-game style: almost-black blue-green matte interior (#091114), extremely thin muted steel teal double outline (#58767b), tiny dull amber gold corner brackets (#b88a32), square corners, crisp orthographic straight-on geometry, no bevel and no perspective. Single square panel filling the entire canvas, border inset only 2% of canvas, empty dark center; designed for Unity uGUI nine-slice stretching, keep decoration entirely at the four corners and the narrow border. At final 620x570 display the lines should read as about 1 pixel thick. No text, symbols, rivets, gradients, large decorations, drop shadow, mockup, surrounding UI or presentation board. Real transparent pixels only outside the panel. It must look like a polished sibling of the reference, not a fantasy frame.
